# Which vacation rental software offers the best integrations with Airbnb, Booking.com, and Vrbo?


by


[Guesty Marketing Team](https://www.guesty.com/blog/author/guesty-marketing-team/)

**The vacation rental software with the best Airbnb, Booking.com, and Vrbo integrations is one that holds top-tier connectivity status with all three platforms, syncs rates, availability, content, reservations, and messages two-way over API in real time, and handles reservation alterations and cancellations without gaps.**


Guesty is a vacation rental software and channel manager that meets all three tests: it is an Airbnb Preferred+ Software Partner, a Booking.com Premier Connectivity Partner, and a Vrbo Elite partner, and it also holds Expedia Preferred and Homes & Villas by Marriott Bonvoy Elite status across 60+ connected booking channels.


This guide explains what “best integration” actually means, how the major short-term rental software platforms compare, and the questions to ask before you choose a property management system (PMS).


**Key takeaways**


- **Guesty connects to Airbnb, Booking.com, Vrbo, Expedia, and 60+ channels** with top-tier partner status on each of the five largest, real-time two-way sync, and native payments and trust accounting
- **API beats iCal.** A direct API connection syncs rates, availability, content, and reservations in seconds. iCal only syncs blocked dates, on a delay of minutes to hours.
- **Partner status is the floor, not the finish line.** Several PMS platforms hold Airbnb Preferred+ status. The difference is whether a platform holds top-tier status with *every* major OTA, and how deep its sync goes.
- **Check alterations and cancellations.** Most double bookings come from changes to existing reservations, not new ones. Ask how a PMS syncs a date change on Airbnb.
- **Look at what happens after the booking.** The best integrations feed reservations straight into payments, accounting, guest messaging, and cleaning tasks — inside one platform.


## What makes a booking channel integration the best?


A strong OTA integration has seven qualities. Use them as a scorecard when you compare vacation rental software.


1. **Direct API connection.** The PMS talks to Airbnb, Booking.com, and Vrbo through each platform’s official API, so changes move both ways in seconds.
2. **Top-tier partner status with every major OTA.** Airbnb, Booking.com, and Vrbo each rank software partners on performance, reliability, and feature adoption. Top status with all three, plus Expedia, signals the integration is maintained to each platform’s highest standard.
3. **Full sync scope.** Rates, availability, listing content, photos, promotions, reservations, and guest messages all sync. Availability-only sync leaves you editing listings by hand.
4. **No alteration or cancellation gaps.** When a guest changes dates on Airbnb, the PMS updates every other channel immediately. This is where most sync failures happen.
5. **Channel-level pricing control.** You can set markups, discounts, and rate plans per channel from one place.
6. **Visibility when something breaks.** Integration health dashboards show listing and connection errors before they cost you bookings.
7. **Native tools downstream.** Each reservation flows into a unified inbox, payments, owner statements, and task automation with no third-party add-ons or extra logins.


## What’s the difference between an API integration and iCal sync?


An API integration is a direct, two-way connection between your PMS and a booking platform. iCal is a one-way calendar file that other platforms check periodically.


Direct API integration iCal sync


What syncs Rates, availability, content, photos, reservations, messages, promotions Blocked dates only


Direction Two-way One-way, per calendar


Speed Seconds Every 15 minutes to several hours


Double-booking risk Very low High during the sync window


Reservation changes Alterations and cancellations sync automatically Must be fixed manually


Best for Any host or property manager listing on two or more channels A single listing on one or two platforms, as a stopgap


If a PMS connects to a major OTA through iCal, treat it as a calendar tool.


## What do Airbnb, Booking.com, and Vrbo partner statuses mean?


Each major booking platform runs a software partner program that ranks connected PMS and[channel manager providers](https://www.guesty.com/blog/best-channel-managers/) .


- **Airbnb Software Partner program:** Airbnb lists partners by tier, with **Preferred+** at the top. Preferred+ partners meet Airbnb’s highest technical and performance standards and get dedicated support from Airbnb’s API team.
- **Booking.com Connectivity Partner Programme:** **Premier Connectivity Partner** recognizes providers that perform well across all program requirements, including syncing rates, availability, content, and promotions, and meeting information security standards.
- **Vrbo and Expedia Group connectivity programs:** **Elite** (Vrbo) and **Preferred** (Expedia) recognize top-performing connectivity partners.


Many platforms share the same Airbnb tier. Airbnb’s own directory lists Guesty, Hostaway, Lodgify, Hospitable, OwnerRez, and Hostfully as Preferred+ partners. The stronger signal is top-tier status across *every* major channel you list on, combined with sync depth and the tools that act on each booking.

### Hostaway


Hostaway is a property management system and channel manager for vacation rental managers. It holds Airbnb Preferred+, Booking.com Premier Partner, and Vrbo Elite status. Beyond channel management, Hostaway relies on third-party tools from its integration marketplace for core functions such as payments, trust accounting, and owner management.


**Pros**


- Top-tier status with Airbnb, Booking.com, and Vrbo.
- API connections to the major OTAs.


**Cons**


- Payments, trust accounting, and an owner portal run on third-party tools, which means extra logins and separate bills.
- Documented sync gaps on some Airbnb reservation alterations.


### Lodgify


Lodgify is vacation rental software that began as a direct-booking website builder and added channel management and PMS features. It holds Airbnb Preferred+, Booking.com Premier Partner, and Vrbo Elite status and connects to 12 booking channels. Its core strengths are customizable booking websites, a built-in booking engine, and a channel manager aimed at independent hosts and small property managers.


**Pros**


- Top-tier status with Airbnb, Booking.com, and Vrbo.
- Strong website builder and direct booking engine.
- Straightforward setup for hosts with a few listings.


**Cons**


- Connects to 12 booking channels.
- Documented Airbnb sync gaps on alterations and cancellations.
- No NC-compliant trust accounting; reporting and rate setup are limited.


### Hospitable


Hospitable is short-term rental software focused on guest-messaging automation for individual hosts and small operators. It holds Airbnb Preferred+ status and connects to Airbnb, Booking.com, and Vrbo through API connections, with about 11 channels in total. It offers automated messaging, a unified inbox, guidebooks, and a direct booking website.


**Pros**


- Airbnb Preferred+ status.
- Strong automated messaging for Airbnb hosts.
- Simple setup and interface.


**Cons**


- Connects to about 11 channels and is not in Vrbo’s or Expedia’s preferred partner programs.
- Documented sync gaps on cancellations, seasonal discounts, occupancy taxes, and rate plans.
- No native payments, revenue management, or trust accounting.

## What should you ask before choosing a channel manager?


Use these questions on any sales call. The answers show how deep each integration goes.


1. Is each connection to Airbnb, Booking.com, and Vrbo a direct API integration?
2. What is your current partner tier with Airbnb, Booking.com, Vrbo, and Expedia?
3. When a guest changes dates on Airbnb, how fast do my other channels update?
4. Which fields sync: rates, availability, content, photos, promotions, messages?
5. Can I set different prices and rate plans per channel?
6. How do I see and fix listing or connection errors?
7. Are payments, owner statements, and[trust accounting](https://www.guesty.com/blog/why-pms-accounting-makes-all-the-difference/) native, or do I need add-ons?
8. What support is available when a channel connection fails at 2 a.m.?
